rhythm_smallest_level.statement: with 14 healthy calibration recordings the rhythm expert cannot alarm at a level below 1/15, and its p-values are multiples of 1/15, so the design level 0.10 acts as 1/15 for a new case; in the leave-one-out evaluation each healthy recording is ranked among the other 13, so at 1/15 its measured healthy alarm rate is 0 by construction

smallest_p_structure_per_fold: about 1/125 (calibration normal cases of each fold); see wp5_structure_delta
caution: the curves are measured on the evaluation data; choosing a level from them and reporting performance at that level on the same data would be optimistic
